name: Wings of Awakening
source:
Wings of Awakening is a short, experimental musical VN that follows Sarina Valentine during her debut performance as a lead actor in a musical. As Sarina performs the main solo of the musical, she reminisces on her past and the hurtles she had to over come in order to get here. Sarina also notices similarities between the character she plays and herself.

[From [url=https://ashelucia.itch.io/wings-of-awakening]itch.io[/url]]
